# "Why we do this" Section Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Insert a new unnumbered "why we do this" belief-statement section into the Bilt Studio landing page, between the post-hero CTA strip and "01/The problem."

**Architecture:** Single hand-patched insertion into `site/index.html` (a generated file that gets hand-patched directly — see Global Constraints). One new image asset copied into `site/img-stock/`. No JS, no new CSS files, no build-script changes. Two-column layout reusing the `data-two` responsive helper already wired up in `index.html`'s inline controller script.

**Tech Stack:** Plain HTML with inline styles (no CSS framework, no build step) — matches the rest of `site/index.html`. Verification is manual/browser-based (this codebase has no test runner), via the project's existing preview server.

## Global Constraints

- Spec source of truth: `site/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-19-why-we-do-it-design.md`. Copy, layout values, and placement must match it exactly.
- `site/index.html` is generated by `site/_build.py` and gets silently overwritten if that script runs again (per `site/BILT_STUDIO_HANDOFF.md` §2, §8). This is a hand-patch, same as the site's existing tech-cabinetry section and stock-photo swaps — expected and accepted, not a bug to fix.
- No new facts, brands, review counts, or founder claims — the copy is fixed by the spec, verbatim.
- Section id is `bl-why`. It is **not** numbered (no `NN /` prefix in its eyebrow) and must **not** trigger any renumbering of the existing `01`–`11` eyebrows elsewhere on the page.
- Do not add a `data-mock` attribute to the new image column — `js` in `index.html` selects `[data-mock]` with `document.querySelector` (first-match-only), and `bl-planner` already owns that attribute. Adding it here would silently break `bl-planner`'s responsive border. Use a static `border-top` instead (see Task 2).
- Preview server: launch.json config `bilt-site`, port 4530, serves the `site/` directory (`npx serve site --listen 4530`).

### Task 2: Insert the `bl-why` section into `index.html`

**Files:**
- Modify: `site/index.html` — insert immediately before the line containing `<section id="bl-problem" style="padding:clamp(4.5rem,12vh,8rem) 0 0">` (this exact string appears exactly once in the file; it is the opening tag of the very next section, so inserting immediately before it places the new section directly after `bl-convert` and before `bl-problem`, per spec).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `img-stock/why-we-do-this.jpg` from Task 1.
- Produces: a `<section id="bl-why">` element in the DOM, positioned between `#bl-convert` and `#bl-problem`. No other task depends on this section's internals.

- [ ] **Step 1: Locate the exact insertion anchor**

Run: `grep -n 'id="bl-problem" style="padding:clamp(4.5rem,12vh,8rem) 0 0"' "C:\Users\WIN10\Desktop\CLAUDE STORAGE\site\index.html"`
Expected: exactly one match. Note the line number.

- [ ] **Step 2: Insert the new section**

Using the Edit tool on `C:\Users\WIN10\Desktop\CLAUDE STORAGE\site\index.html`, replace:

```html
<section id="bl-problem" style="padding:clamp(4.5rem,12vh,8rem) 0 0">
```

with:

```html
<section id="bl-why" style="padding:clamp(4.5rem,12vh,8rem) 0 0">
  <p style="margin:0;padding:0 clamp(1.25rem,5vw,5rem);font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8D9698;display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:center"><span>Why we do this</span><span style="flex:1;height:1px;background:rgba(141,150,152,.28)"></span></p>
  <div data-rev="1" style="display:grid;gap:0;grid-template-columns:1fr;margin-top:clamp(2rem,6vh,3.25rem)" data-two="1">
    <div style="background:#16130F">
      <img src="img-stock/why-we-do-this.jpg" alt="Marble kitchen island with brass pendant lighting." style="width:100%;height:clamp(20rem,60vh,34rem);object-fit:cover;display:block">
    </div>
    <div style="background:#16130F;border-top:1px solid rgba(141,150,152,.22);padding:clamp(2.5rem,7vh,4rem) clamp(1.25rem,5vw,5rem);display:grid;align-content:center;gap:1.5rem">
      <p style="margin:0;font-family:'Newsreader',Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(1.75rem,1.4rem + 2vw,3rem);line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#E7E4DD;max-width:18ch">A kitchen quote should be a number, not a negotiation.</p>
      <p style="margin:0;font-size:clamp(1.1rem,1rem + .55vw,1.5rem);line-height:1.45;color:#D8D3C9;max-width:38ch;font-weight:300">We got tired of quotes that changed depending on how the room read, showrooms you pay for whether you buy or not, and a salesperson standing between you and a straight answer. So we built the version where the number is just the number. Draw your kitchen, see what it costs, decide with nothing hidden.</p>
    </div>

</section>
<section id="bl-problem" style="padding:clamp(4.5rem,12vh,8rem) 0 0">
```

(Note: the original `<section id="bl-problem" ...>` opening tag is kept, unchanged, immediately after the new section — this insertion adds content, it does not alter `bl-problem` itself.)

### Task 3: Verify in the browser

**Files:** none (verification only).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the running preview server (`bilt-site`, port 4530) serving the `site/` directory, and the `bl-why` section produced by Task 2.
- Produces: nothing further downstream — this is the final task.

- [ ] **Step 1: Start (or reuse) the preview server**

Use the `preview_start` tool with `{name: "bilt-site"}`. If already running, it will be reused on port 4530.

- [ ] **Step 2: Hard-reload the page**

Navigate the browser tab to `http://localhost:4530`, then run in the page:
```javascript
location.reload(true);
```
(A hard reload is required because `npx serve` and the browser both cache aggressively — confirmed necessary in this exact codebase during the earlier tech-cabinetry section work.)

- [ ] **Step 3: Scroll to the new section and screenshot**

Run in the page:
```javascript
document.getElementById('bl-why').scrollIntoView();
```
Then take a screenshot with the `computer` tool (`action: "screenshot"`).
Expected: visible eyebrow "WHY WE DO THIS" (no number), the italic statement "A kitchen quote should be a number, not a negotiation.", the supporting paragraph, and the marble-island photo — either stacked (mobile width) or side-by-side (desktop width ≥940px).

- [ ] **Step 4: Confirm the image request succeeded**

Use `read_network_requests` with `urlPattern: "why-we-do-this"`.
Expected: `GET http://localhost:4530/img-stock/why-we-do-this.jpg → 200 OK`.

- [ ] **Step 5: Confirm no console errors**

Use `read_console_messages` with `onlyErrors: true`.
Expected: no logs.

- [ ] **Step 6: Confirm the two-column breakpoint works**

Resize the browser to desktop width (≥940px, e.g. 1440×900) and re-screenshot the section (repeat Step 3's scroll first, since resizing can reset scroll position).
Expected: photo and text sit side by side, not stacked.

- [ ] **Step 7: Confirm `bl-planner`'s layout is unaffected**

Run in the page:
```javascript
document.getElementById('bl-planner').scrollIntoView();
```
Screenshot it at desktop width.
Expected: the planner's live-price mock panel still shows its left border correctly (i.e. it still looks exactly as it did before this change — this step exists specifically to catch the `data-mock` singleton bug called out in Global Constraints, in case it was accidentally reintroduced).

No commit for this task — it is verification-only. If any expectation fails, fix the issue in Task 2's file and re-run this task's steps from Step 2.
